journey.name: send spending limit refreshes after receiving lightning
journey.description:
Android regression for an already usable channel whose cached outbound capacity is zero before receiving funds. Fresh balance derivation must not be overwritten by that stale channel snapshot when an amountless Lightning invoice opens Send. The shared Send2 E2E fixture prepares this state.
Precondition: a fresh dev wallet with Savings funded, a usable inbound local-LND channel, and zero Spending. Prepare an amountless invoice from that LND node for the outgoing recipient. Start on wallet home. Do not restart the app or manually refresh after receiving the Lightning payment.

actions.action: Receive exactly 10 000 sats through the usable Lightning channel and acknowledge the received-payment sheet
Verify Spending shows 10 000 sats on wallet home
Tap Send (testTag "Send"), handle any camera permission prompt, and tap Enter Manually (testTag "RecipientManual")
Enter the prepared amountless Lightning invoice in RecipientInput and tap AddressContinue
Verify SendNumberField is visible and the Spending funding source is selected
Tap N1, N0, N0, and N0, verifying SendNumberField reads 1 000 sats
Tap N1 once and immediately verify SendAmountExceededToast appears
Verify SendNumberField still reads 1 000 sats; do not repeat the rejected keypress
Dismiss Send and reopen the same amountless invoice
Enter 2 000 sats and verify ContinueAmount is enabled and opens payment review showing 2 000 sats
